g0.rationale: RESOLVED BY R1 (2026-09-14): the charter's named example was mistaken on the facts and has been corrected; this product is eligible, mode-scoped. The §2.2 five-step derivation below is unchanged and is now the charter's own worked case. || THE COHORT'S OPEN G0 QUESTION, RESOLVED AGAINST THE CHARTER'S ASSUMPTION. §2.2's five-step test run verbatim on the frozen directions. STEP 1 — authoritative directions located: 'Als Spülung (für sofortige Regeneration): ins gewaschene, nasse Haar einmassieren, kurz einwirken lassen (ca. 30 Sekunden) und gut ausspülen. Als Kur (für Tiefenregeneration): ins gewaschene, nasse Haar einmassieren, 2-3 Minuten einwirken lassen und genießen, dann ausspülen.' STEP 2 — test each stated mode against §2.1. Mode A 'Als Spülung': after cleansing YES ('ins gewaschene, nasse Haar'); stated contact time YES (ca. 30 Sekunden); rinse YES ('gut ausspülen'); but the mode is self-labelled a Spülung, i.e. a conditioner, and §2.1's category definition requires a rinse-out INTENSIVE TREATMENT (Haarkur/Maske). Mode A is a conditioner mode. Mode B 'Als Kur': after cleansing YES (identical wording); stated contact time YES (2–3 Minuten); rinse YES ('dann ausspülen'); self-labelled a Kur and explicitly purposed 'für Tiefenregeneration'. Mode B IS a qualifying rinse-out mask mode. STEP 3 — exactly one mode qualifies as a MASK mode → classify only that mode, record multi_use: true, name the uncovered mode. STEP 4 not reached (a mode does qualify). STEP 5 not reached: the directions are NOT ambiguous about which mode carries which dwell — the modes are separately named, separately purposed, and carry distinct stated contact times — so `multi_use_directions_ambiguity` does NOT fire. Charter F1 is what governs, and F1's own text says a multi-use product is eligible 'when authoritative directions state a distinct rinse-out mask mode with dwell'. These directions do exactly that.
evidenceSignals: directions mode B verbatim: 'Als Kur (für Tiefenregeneration): ins gewaschene, nasse Haar einmassieren, 2-3 Minuten einwirken lassen und genießen, dann ausspülen'
directions mode A verbatim: 'Als Spülung (für sofortige Regeneration): … kurz einwirken lassen (ca. 30 Sekunden) und gut ausspülen'

the two modes are separately named ('Als Spülung' / 'Als Kur'), separately purposed ('sofortige Regeneration' / 'Tiefenregeneration'), and carry distinct contact times — they are separable, so §2.2 step 5 is not reached
charter F2 (binding): dwell is protocol metadata under P5 and is NEVER a boundary test, so the shortness of either mode cannot decide eligibility
charter F1: eligible when authoritative directions state a distinct rinse-out mask mode with dwell

charterResolution.ruling: R1 (Nick, 2026-09-14) — CORRECT THE CHARTER. The directions test decides (charter F1); the 2–3-minute Kur mode is mask territory; classification is mode-scoped.
charterResolution.what_was_wrong: The charter's exclusion rested on the factual premise that this product's only rinse-out mode is a short conditioner mode. The frozen directions falsify that premise: there are two rinse-out modes, and the second is a self-labelled Kur with a 2–3 minute stated dwell and a Tiefenregeneration purpose. v0.1's AP-12-CHARTERFLIP escalated exactly this, offering resolution (A) correct the example or (B) write a label-based 2in1 exclusion narrowing F1. Nick ruled (A). Standard v0.2 §2.1 and §2.2 are rewritten accordingly, and §2.2 now carries this product as the worked case rather than as the excluded example.
charterResolution.restated_principle: No MODE is ever profiled twice. A multi-mode product may hold ONE profile per engine, each covering exactly one mode. This product's Conditioner-engine profile for the 30-second Spülung mode is untouched and not in conflict with the mask profile for its Kur mode.
charterResolution.status: RESOLVED. The profile in this record is OFFICIAL, not provisional. The v0.1 withdrawal scenario ('if Nick rules (B), this record's entire profile is withdrawn') is void.

tailMarker.anomalyNote: No §3.1 anomaly. Read as a closed enumeration, it is not a marker and tail_index stays at 12. Had it counted, the credited segment would shrink from eleven entries to six, S3 would fail, and conditioning_level would drop from high to moderate. See AP-12-CHELATOR.  ||  TAIL MARKER RE-CHECKED UNDER v0.2 (R8 tail-class union list + R2 plausibility). v0.1's AP-12-CHELATOR turned on whether TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE @7 is tail-class; the standard's §3.1 list and lexicon §0.2/§10 now carry ONE reconciled union list and TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE is explicitly ON it (R8, 2026-09-14). ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN @9 is likewise now marker-eligible, as a preservative booster declared alongside PHENOXYETHANOL @12. The earliest marker-eligible species is therefore TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE @7, not PHENOXYETHANOL @12: tail_index moves from 12 to 7 and the credited segment shrinks from eleven entries to six. AP-12-CHELATOR is closed by rule, in the direction v0.1 flagged as the more honest one. PLAUSIBILITY ASSESSMENT (R2, §3.1.1): PLAUSIBLE - CETEARYL ALCOHOL @2, BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @3 and CETYL ESTERS @5 outrank @7, and the product is a conventional O/W emulsion with AQUA @1. AVENA SATIVA KERNEL OIL @11, which carried S3 in v0.1, is now an ordinary tail member and carries nothing.  ||  RE-CHECKED UNDER v0.3 (E1, E2). E2's third plausibility limb does NOT fire: TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE @7 is a chelator, its class is not ordered against any other tail class on this list in a contradictory way, and the list's fragrance entries (PARFUM @13, VANILLIN @14) sit BELOW the preservative block (ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN @9, PHENOXYETHANOL @12) in an ordinarily consistent arrangement; no declared allergen outranks its own PARFUM. The marker stays PLAUSIBLE at rank 7. E1: PANTHENOL @6 is the tail_index - 1 species and now counts normally everywhere (no strike). It carries no S1/S2/S3 signal and no §9.2 term, and it was already counted in full toward the §9.5.3 humectant cluster, so it is NOT load-bearing for any value and no `boundary_position_ingredient` flag fires.

Step 4 `moisture` blocked at §9.5.3 criterion 1 (two humectants against three). Step 5 `shine` blocked (no alignment-oriented R2/R3 route). Step 6 `smoothing` blocked (no silicone, no substantive polymer, two light emollients are not a material extension beyond the base). Step 7 `detangling` blocked (slip is baseline on a single cationic). Step 8 `general` is reached and taken.
thresholdReasoning: Clears `general`: step 8's honest fallback — a capable conventional mask where no specific focus clears the differentiator threshold and the formula evidence is nonspecific. Every earlier step was tested and named above, which is what step 8 requires before it may be taken.

`lightness` does not apply, and this is the value that MOVED — twice, in opposite directions, within one revision. E4 made `weight_potential: low` reachable, which unlocked step 3's two-condition `lightness` route and displaced this record's `general` headline; the move was recorded and escalated rather than smoothed over (AP-12-LIGHTNESSUNLOCKED). E6 answers that escalation by removing the value from the vocabulary, so the route no longer exists to be cleared. The record returns to the value it held under v0.1 and v0.2, by the same step-8 path.

`moisture` does not apply, unchanged across all three revisions: §9.5.3 criterion 1 needs ≥ 3 distinct humectants above the tail with ≥ 2 non-glycerin; DIPROPYLENE GLYCOL @4 and PANTHENOL @6 give two. Counting GLYCINE would give three and — this formula containing no glycerin at all — would trivially satisfy the non-glycerin sub-condition; it is not counted. This is the near-miss AP-05-NOGLYCERIN predicted, and under v0.3 it is no longer moot: with step 3 clearing nothing, criterion 3 no longer blocks the headline, so the two-versus-three count is now the ONLY thing standing between this record and a `moisture` headline. Recorded as a live calibration item rather than a settled call.
`moisture` as a SECONDARY is also refused, for the same reason: §9.5.3 criterion 3 opens the secondary slot only where the cluster independently meets criterion 1, and it does not.

`repair` does not apply and the gap is worth naming: this is the cohort's clearest claim/formula mismatch on the repair axis — 'Panthenol + Reparatur' and 'schützt vor Haarbruch' against no protein species, no peptide and no bond token at any rank. §9.5.2 step 3 and §9.5.1's hard rule both forbid a claim creating the route; the mismatch is carried in `hinweise` and moves nothing.
`smoothing`, `shine` and `detangling` do not apply: no silicone, no substantive polymer, no alignment-oriented route, and slip is baseline in this category on a single cationic.

Confidence `moderate`: `general` is a fallback rather than a positively earned route, the moisture near-miss above is one counted species away from a different headline, and the single fallback-tier source (hautschutzengel; dm.de and Rossmann.de both blocked) caps this record throughout.
